items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 15:1
items.html: (To the question) They are the aspect of the Mochin that the lower one receives in the place of their emergence, namely in the head of the upper one. For the Ibur of ZA is made in the place of the head of Aba and Ima, who stand in the GAR of AA; therefore, when he is born from there, he clothes from the mouth and below of AA. And likewise the Nukva is found there, receiving the Mochin from the place of the head of ZA; therefore she is with him in an equal stature. (Item 12).
